content.title: Start Here
content.subtitle: One page to understand what this site holds and choose where to begin. Read this first, five minutes, before jumping to any chapter.

blocks.html: Two things are taught here at once: school mathematics and JRG, a programming language. They are taught together because each helps the other — writing a formula as code forces us to understand it down to the details, and the computer tells us right away when our understanding is wrong.
You do not need to install anything. Every code example has a Run button that really runs the JRG code, right here in this browser, and an Edit button to change it first.
